evidence.finding: The frozen composition assumes all-time hfilter. The existing finite_barrier can support a simultaneous tracking/filter box proof.

task.name: Joint tracking/filter invariant for un-clipped first-order filtering on constant-jerk segments
task.scope: Actual plant and reference ODEs, initial joint box, explicit parameter budgets, retained filter at matched finite replans.
task.parameters: sigma>0, lambda>0, H>=0, R>0, D>0, W>=0, J>=0
task.conclusion: For all t in [0,H], abs(z_i(t))<=R and abs(u(t)-u_star(t))<=D.
forbidden_hidden_premises: all-time nominal-command derivative bound derived from the desired tracking result

acceptance.B: Prove the actual-trajectory joint segment theorem with explicit initial and parameter assumptions; check nonempty witness; fresh build, axiom audit, kernel replay, and targeted negative control pass.
acceptance.A: All B checks pass on independent replay; prove retained-state matched handoff and finite-segment composition with the state-dependent admission rule; check a nonzero accepted jerk change and retain the rejected large-jump limitation.
acceptance.counterexample: A verified counterexample satisfying all stated hypotheses can earn B or A if it closes this construction.

stop_condition: One builder batch, then independent grading. Redirect once for circular all-time premises. Pause if repeated, or if a checked counterexample defeats the budgets. A stalled formalization must identify the exact missing lemma and last passed check.
